_about: Challenge lines for the enemies standing in the test room (data/world/room_fights.json). Re-toned 2026-10-08 (grim world, Writer pass): the Signals are tired conscripts with quotas, and they still mean it. Short and dry, nothing cartoony. PLACEHOLDER until the M6-2 sign-off. Each ends in a Fight? choice; the yes conversation plays and then the fight starts.

challenge_grunt.speaker: enemy_grunt
challenge_grunt.text: HALT. Signals Patrol. Permit for standing there?

challenge_grunt.speaker: enemy_grunt
challenge_grunt.text: ...Neither do I. Fight me. It's that or paperwork.

challenge_grunt_yes.speaker: enemy_grunt
challenge_grunt_yes.text: Form up, Patrol. ...Both of us. Form up.

challenge_grunt_no.speaker: enemy_grunt
challenge_grunt_no.text: Fine. Ticket for refusing. It's the last one I need for my quota.

challenge_drone.speaker: enemy_drone
challenge_drone.text: BZZT. Intruder detected. Unlicensed footsteps. Also: we are a flock.

challenge_drone_no.speaker: enemy_drone
challenge_drone_no.text: Bzzt... scheduled for later. Everything is scheduled.

challenge_squad.speaker: enemy_squad
challenge_squad.text: ATTENTION. Full Signals Squad. Four of us. Count us. Sarge checks.

challenge_squad.speaker: enemy_squad
challenge_squad.text: One, two, three... Fight us. Please. We need a win on the sheet.

challenge_squad_yes.speaker: enemy_squad
challenge_squad_yes.text: SQUAD! BY THE NUMBERS! ...Mine's 4466. Nobody asked. Fight!

challenge_squad_no.speaker: enemy_squad
challenge_squad_no.text: Smart. We were only three-and-a-half sure.

challenge_tough.speaker: enemy_tough
challenge_tough.text: I am the QUOTA ENFORCER. Nobody leaves my quota.

challenge_tough.speaker: enemy_tough
challenge_tough.text: No running. No refunds. No appeals. FIGHT.

challenge_tough_no.speaker: enemy_tough
challenge_tough_no.text: Hmph. The quota will wait. It's very patient.
